proposed_widenings.name: item_lifecycle_becomes_nonmagical_on_hit
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item surface can encode the rarity-scaled attack and damage bonuses, but it cannot encode an ammunition piece that loses only its magical property after a hit while remaining a mundane item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

notes: Authored as a magic-item variant collection with passive rarity-scaled attack and damage bonuses using existing atoms. Typecheck and tracer both passed. Quantity/value text was treated as catalog metadata, not combat mechanics.
